newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat firm on FOB sales.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat firm on FOB sales.

text.p: Argentine cash January wheat firmed in moderate volume trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with prices buoyed by FOB sales, traders said.

Trading was done at $128, just below a great mass of sellers at $130, a trader said, adding that farmers are keen to sell quickly this season to avoid the predicted harvest bottlenecks. Other grain trading was sapped by today's general strike, which prompted some to take a long weekend. New crop cash maize and soybeans were down in slow trade on a lower CBOT, bearish world crop outlook, and forecasts of more rain. March sunflower seed slipped on weak oil prices and good European crop prospects.
